newsitem.title: BRAZIL: RESEARCH ALERT - Bradesco maintained as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Bradesco maintained as buy.

text.p: -- Salomon Brothers said it was maintaining its buy rating on Bradesco, Brazil's largest private bank.
-- Bradesco reported a net income of 824 million reais in 1996, according to corporate law accounting, it said in a report.
-- Salomon Brothers also said the bank has not yet released inflation-adjusted figures, which are used by the brokerage to analyze the bank.
-- Bradesco preferred shares were down 2.84 percent at 8.55 reais earlier on the Sao Paulo bourse.
